evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/facilities/pages/PendingBookingsPage.tsx:55-66 — handleApprove awaits the approve-booking mutation inside try/catch, and on failure the catch body is ONLY `console.error('Failed to approve booking:', error)`. No setState, no alert, no toast, no error banner. A manager clicks Approve on a pending facility booking; if the API rejects it (409 conflict, RLS denial, network), the UI gives zero feedback — the row silently stays pending and the manager assumes it worked.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/facilities/pages/PendingBookingsPage.tsx:74-84 — handleRejectConfirm has the same shape: on the success path it closes the RejectBookingDialog (setRejectDialogBooking(null)); on the catch path it only console.errors, so a failed rejection leaves the dialog open with no message explaining why nothing happened.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/facilities/pages/MyBookingsPage.tsx:67-77 — handleCancel (tenant-initiated booking cancellation) catches and only console.errors; a failed cancel is invisible to the tenant, who believes their booking was cancelled.

This is a codebase-inconsistency defect, not a style nit: the sibling feature page frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/emergency/pages/EmergencyContactDirectoryPage.tsx:106-159 establishes the correct pattern — every mutation catch does `setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : t('emergency.errors.failed...'))` AND console.error, rendering a visible error. The facilities booking pages omit the user-facing half. Fix: add an error state (or toast) surfaced in the same i18n style, matching EmergencyContactDirectoryPage.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/registry/pages/RegistryPage.tsx:98-109 — handlePetDelete confirms via window.confirm then `await deletePetMutation.mutateAsync(id)`; the catch body is ONLY `console.error('Failed to delete pet registration:', error)`. A destructive delete that fails (RLS denial, 404, network) shows the user nothing. The grep-verified fact that the whole file contains no setError / setFormError / alert / toast / notify / onError means EVERY mutation failure on this page is swallowed.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/registry/pages/RegistryPage.tsx:111-126 — handlePetReview (approve) and lines 155-183 handleVehicleDelete / handleVehicleReview repeat the identical silent-catch anti-pattern for the vehicle registry. Four user-facing mutations (2 destructive deletes, 2 approvals), all failing silently.

Contrast with the established convention in EmergencyContactDirectoryPage.tsx:106-159 (setError + i18n key + console.error) — RegistryPage implements only the console.error half, so a manager whose delete/approve silently fails has no signal to retry. Fix: introduce an error state surfaced in the UI (matching the emergency page), so failed destructive/approval actions are visible.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/registry/pages/RegistryPage.tsx:111-126 — handlePetReview hardcodes `data: { approve: true }` and is guarded only by `window.confirm('Approve this pet registration?')`. There is no reject path: a manager can approve a pending pet registration but cannot reject one from this screen. Same for handleVehicleReview at lines 168-183.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/registry/pages/RegistryPage.tsx:113 — the code self-documents the gap: `// Simple approval - in a real app, this would open a modal to approve/reject with reason`. The review API is a two-outcome decision (approve boolean) but the UI wires only the approve=true branch, so the reject half of the moderation workflow is unreachable and no rejection reason can be captured.

Compare with the facilities feature, which ships a proper RejectBookingDialog capturing a reason (PendingBookingsPage.tsx / components/RejectBookingDialog). The registry review flow should offer an equivalent approve/reject choice with reason capture instead of a confirm-and-approve-only stub. Completeness gap, low severity: managers currently must delete a registration they intend to reject, losing the audit distinction between 'rejected' and 'deleted'.
